problem: The production workflow could fall back before the Git-linked Netlify deploy had enough time to become observable, creating unnecessary transport churn and confusing production state.
root_cause: The bounded wait for the native Git-linked Netlify production deploy was shorter than the provider's real completion latency during busy delivery periods, so fallback transport could be attempted while the linked deploy was still viable.
prevention_rule: Give the native Git-linked production deploy a longer bounded observation window before activating exact-source fallback, while keeping exact-SHA readback and bounded failure behavior.
